finalText:
**Build passes now, exit 0.**

Two real bugs, both from the shape/default changes the bump brought in:

- `[src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6)` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read the right field.
- `[src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7)` threw on unset flags because the new config loader leaves them `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

The rest, `DEP0142`/`DEP0198`/etc., are just deprecation noise from the bumped packages, not bugs. Build now finishes clean: `8 warnings, 0 errors`.
